title: arm-chaos-fi fault-injection manifest (v1 + v2)
description: Per-run manifest for the ARM64 CHAOS SDC fault-injection campaign (plan §5.1, §1.6). One manifest == exactly one deterministic fault (max_faults=1). v2 (§1.6) is ADDITIVE: it widens target.component, adds target.sub_field/semantic_role, fault.f5_substitute_target/f6_phase_offset/trigger_value_pattern, and the dynamic_context provenance block. All v2 fields are OPTIONAL so existing v1 manifests validate unchanged. S1 injectors (rat/freelist/rob/iq/...) are forward-declared in the component enum; runner.py rejects unmapped components with a clear error (§1.6 honest-reject) until their mapping patch lands.

config_profile.description: Microarchitecture profile; B0 is the workbook/O3_ARM_v7a_3 point and is verified against config.ini.

sub_field.description: §1.6 v2: structural sub-field, e.g. pfn/ap/asid (TLB), src_ready/dst_tag (IQ), map_entry/free_bit (RAT)

f5_substitute_target.description: §1.6 v2 (F5 legal-domain substitute): description of the substitution target (e.g. 'another currently-allocated physReg','another legal tag','another mapped active page pfn')

f6_phase_offset.description: §1.6 v2 (F6 delay/omission): phase offset in issue/fwd slots (e.g. -2..+2); models method3 timing-race phase shift

trigger_value_pattern.description: §1.6 v2 (F3 data-dependent trigger): hex pattern; inject only when (target_val & triggerValueMask)==pattern (method2 undervoltage setup-time violation)

fpu_mode.description: v1.1 Phase 9: CHAOSFPU mode selection (task_plan 1a). Exactly one mode flag per manifest.

precision.description: FP precision for the field table. FP64 fields require lane_width 64; FP32 fields require lane_width >= 32.

lane_offset.description: Lane index inside the 128-bit vector register; < 128/lane_width.

decode_guard.description: Reject candidates whose real AArch64 decode disagrees with precision/lane_width/lane_offset (fail closed).

op_classes.description: [FSU][FP06] Explicit eligible-opClass allowlist. An empty/absent list keeps the legacy behavior (every FP opClass this injector accepts). Names are exact gem5 OpClass names.

reg_class.description: [FSU][FP06] Target destination register class. Only a dest of this class is eligible; empty/absent = any FP register class (legacy).

prf_wb_hook.description: [FSU][FR07-HOOK v2] Inject at the PRF writeback-data boundary: arm before execute, route the destination through a shadow WB buffer (vector) or mask the value before regFile.setReg (scalar), then commit the masked value to the PRF. Requires an explicit fault_mask and an F0-style single-fault mode; incompatible with permanent_stuck/count_only/rate/recurring_stuck/fma_weighted/rounding_sub/f3_dependent/fpsr_suppress.

permanent_stuck.description: [FSU][F5] Install exactly ONE permanent stuck-at fault (one fault_id, one fault_mask, one polarity) on the first eligible event after f5_warmup; every later eligible event is an exposure of the SAME fault. This is forced polarity, NOT XOR. Requires freq=F5, probability=1.0, an explicit fault_mask, max_faults=0/1, and is mutually exclusive with rate/recurring_stuck/rounding_sub/f3_dependent/fpsr_suppress/fma_weighted/bitseg.

stuck_polarity.description: [FSU][F5] -1 = draw the polarity ONCE at installation from rngSeed and keep it fixed; 0 = SA0 (force target bits to 0); 1 = SA1 (force target bits to 1). Formal seeds must pin 0 or 1 before the run.

f5_warmup.description: [FSU][F5] Number of eligible events observed before the single installation. The first eligible event with ordinal > f5_warmup installs the fault.

f5_sample_limit.description: [FSU][F5] Budget for ORDINARY exposure samples (mandatory install/first/first-activated/chain_end events are extra). 0 = mandatory events only. The resolved budget must stay below the 200000 PROP-EVT cap (constructor requires +8 < 190000).

f5_keep_first_last_n.description: [FSU][F5] 0 = prefix sampling (first f5_sample_limit ordinary samples); N>0 = keep the first N and the last N inside the same budget. Totals/dropped remain exact on chain_end.

addr_window.description: v1.1 Phase 11: directed physical DRAM byte window for the memory component.

target_block_addr.description: v1.1 Phase 11: directed cache-block address for the l1d/l2 components.

l2_size.description: v1.1 Phase 11: L2 capacity sweep (cache components).

dynamic_context.description: §9.2 v2 provenance: post-run observed context at the injection point (filled by the runner/analysis, optional in the manifest as a forward-declared schema).

tol.description: v1.1 Phase 8.1: ULP tolerance for kind=fp_ulp (ULP <= tol -> Masked)

events_to_skip.description: v1.1 Phase 8.2: FIXED eligible-event skip (driver-computed uniform draw). Absent = injector's legacy geometric(0.1).

count_only.description: v1.1 Phase 8.2 countOnlyMode dry-run: count eligible events (CHAOS_ELIGIBLE_COUNT in the injector log), never corrupt.
